messages:
clara: Heads-up: started seeing intermittent 502s from prod-eu on /api/generate around 23:47 UTC. Root cause appears to be a header-parse edge-case when clients send very long X-User-Agent. I pushed a focused guard (sha: 9f4e1c2) that trims/normalizes the header. No DB or config changes. Requesting expedited deploy in tonight's 00:30-01:00 UTC window.

deploybot: Deploy request received for redwood/api:hotfix-9f4e1c2. Canary plan: 10% for 5m -> 100% if healthy. Please ACK +1 (owners/oncall).

sam (eng-oncall): +1. Ran quick staging smoke against the image; sample latest request returned 200. No encoder warnings in logs.

maria (release-manager): +1. Locking the window 00:30-01:00 UTC. Add rollback commands to this thread and publish final release note before finalize.

irfan (sre): Rollback ready. Two quick options below. I'll watch LB errors and pod restarts during rollout.

Rollback (image swap):
`kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:main -n prod-eu && kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n prod-eu`

Rollback (undo):
`kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod-eu --to-revision=312`

clara: Canary started at 00:33 UTC (10%). Initial telemetry: no 5xx spike, CPU/memory normal, KV hitrate steady.

sam: +1 to promote at +6m if still clean. I'll watch traces for header exceptions.

deploybot: Promoting to 100% traffic at 00:39 UTC... promotion complete. All pods updated.

irfan: Dashboards green. No restarts, latency within SLO.

maria: Final smoke passed. Published release note: "Hotfix 9f4e1c2: normalize long UA/header parsing to prevent intermittent 502s in EU." Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/9f4e1c2

clara: Thanks team, nice and smooth. If anything pops, use the rollback commands above and ping #eng-oncall.
